name: Standard-Codec-in-the-Loop (SCL)
definition: A training framework that inserts standard, non-differentiable codecs directly into the neural radiance field training loop using a straight-through estimator (STE) to pass gradients.
summary: Standard-Codec-in-the-Loop inserts non-differentiable codecs into neural radiance field training using straight-through estimators to bypass quantization, enabling optimization with arbitrary off-the-shelf compression standards.
